subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between T and S when counted from the right of T. Only one person sits between S and C. Only one person sits between T and R. Only two people sit between A and C. Only one person sits between B and R. Who sits third to the right of D?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only one person sits between T and S when counted from the right of T.

Only one person sits between S and C. Only one person sits between T and R.

Only two people sit between A and C. Only one person sits between B and R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/831cc4c208d16d72adb92a45461ef0cbb4631aac3e54203b301120bcfbfb9589.png] 

Thus, S sits third to the right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
